# A sample for the prose command line

This file is a synthetic fixture. It exists so that `prose lint`, `prose report`
and `prose fix` have something in the repository to read, and it is written
badly on purpose.

In order to utilize the new system, it is very important that users basically
read the instructions. The report was written by the team, and it was reviewed
by the manager in a timely manner. At this point in time we are going to leverage
our synergies.

Short sentence. Another one. This sentence, which goes on for rather longer than
any of the others around it, is there so the sentence-length spread has
something to measure and the readability grades have enough text to work with.
